name: @intellectual-frontiers/telemetry
description: OpenTelemetry-native signals for TypeScript, written from the specification itself with no OpenTelemetry package: the data model, W3C Trace Context, OTLP/HTTP JSON, typed signals, a pure renderer of the console, and a host that exports, journals and shows them; the same code on Bun and Node 26.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../ts/mizan/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/ && bun tools/pack.ts --check
